Plasma heme and oxidative readouts were measured as host/context and biochemical correlates, not infected-host treatment outcomes.
primary_outcome: Plasma heme was 3.5 +/- 0.7 micromolar in severe-malaria subjects versus 0.3 +/- 0.2 micromolar in normal subjects (n=6 each). host_control_or_selectivity: Quinoline drugs were tested as pharmacologic comparators; vitamin E was used as an antioxidant perturbation; severe-malaria and normal plasma provided a heme-context comparison. No mammalian selectivity, in-vivo artemisinin intervention, pharmacokinetic, residue, or whole-plant preparation endpoint was included.
constituent_attribution: The full-text experiment supports a heme- and redox-dependent potentiation model for purified artemisinin in a synchronized blood-stage assay.
